summary: This bill establishes a new temporary visa category for relatives of U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents to visit the U.S. for family purposes, requiring financial support, health insurance, and a sworn intent to depart, with a maximum stay of 90 days per year.

scores.thoughts: This bill creates a new nonimmigrant visa category for relatives of U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents to visit temporarily for family purposes. While it facilitates temporary entry, it includes provisions to prevent overstays and does not grant permanent residency, thus increasing temporary immigration but with controls.
